findings.prompt_en: Complete with the correct past-tense verb and article: ‘As soon as {friendF} ___ (see) the notice, she joined ___ art club.’
findings.why: Second blank has two grammatical answers. 'As soon as she saw the notice, she joined an art club' is a correct sentence, and a class-6 child applying the a/an-before-vowel rule to 'art' will say 'an'. The key and all three acceptable forms take only 'the' ('saw; the', 'saw, the', 'saw the', full sentence with 'the'), so 'saw; an' is marked wrong. Either accept 'an' or make the context force 'the' (e.g. 'the school's art club').
